summary: Feed c051_broker_nic is degraded: NPB-01 port 12 averaged 100% of 10 Gbps and discarded 12.39% on egress (15,149,940 pkts), plus APM eth1 discarded an additional 2.74% (2,938,260 pkts) as capture could not keep up. Sustained oversubscription with bursty loss.

findings.root_cause: NPB-01 port 12 (to APM) is oversubscribed - average load 100% of 10 Gbps with bursts higher - causing 15,149,940 egress discards (12.39% lost). Downstream APM eth1 also discarded 2,938,260 packets it did receive (2.74% lost) indicating the tool's capture interface is overrun.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM loses ~12-15% of traffic before analysis plus additional loss at capture; transactions, latency/error metrics and dependency maps will be incomplete and bursty periods systematically under-represented, severely reducing detection/coverage.

params.suggestion: add 1-2x 10G APM ports to load-balance group or filter to APM-relevant flows to bring sustained load <70% per port

recommended_fix.why: Distributing the feed across multiple 10G tool ports (or filtering to only traffic APM needs - profile needs_full_payload=false) provides headroom for bursts and stops NPB egress drops and APM capture drops. Alternative is tool_capacity upgrade if load-balance not possible.
